content:
Evan (partnerships): Quick update 3 we're scheduling a breaking SDK auth change in v2.1.0: remove legacy x-redwood-auth header, require standard Authorization: Bearer. Target rollout: Wed 2026-03-25. Need partner coordination and marketplace checks.
Priya (platform): Understood. Do we have a list of marketplace images and partner SDKs that will fail? We should map impact before notifications. :eyes: 
Nina (eng-sdk): building an impact matrix now. Will include JS/Go migration snippets and a short FAQ.
Carlos (partner-eng): Heads-up: a few partners embed our v1 sdk in their installer. They need a 2-3 week lead time. @Marketplace Bot, can you scan images for sdk:v1.* references?
Marketplace Bot: Scan queued. Expected results in ~10-15m. Posting back here when ready. :mag:
Evan (partnerships): Things we need to produce today: (1) list of partners/integrations that break when x-redwood-auth is removed, (2) migration examples, (3) fallback/rollback guidance for partners needing extra time. We'll compile a partner-facing email. Keep replies concise.
Priya (platform): Ops suggestion: accept both headers behind a feature flag for a limited overlap window. Ops OK with that?
Nina (eng-sdk): Ops prefers 14 days overlap rather than 30 to limit config drift. I'll gate with a feature flag: 
```
FEATURE_FLAGS={"accept_legacy_auth": true}
# plan to flip to false on 2026-04-08 in controlled regions
```
Nina (eng-sdk): JS migration snippet: 
```
// v1.x (legacy)
const headers = { 'x-redwood-auth': OLD_KEY };
// v2.1.0 (new)
const headers = { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}` };
```
Carlos (partner-eng): Draft partner message: "We will deprecate x-redwood-auth on 2026-04-08. Please migrate to Authorization: Bearer tokens by then. Reply with CI/CD cutoff dates if you need an exception." Offer assisted migration calls? :phone:
Evan (partnerships): Yes. Schedule two 30-min office hours next week + targeted support for top 5 partners. Nina, can you draft a 1-page rollback runbook in case the flag flip creates regressions?
Nina (eng-sdk): Will do. Minimal rollback steps: (1) re-enable accept_legacy_auth flag, (2) redeploy previous sdk-compatible image, (3) open hotfix channel and escalate. I'll deliver a concise runbook.
Marketplace Bot: Scan complete. Found 12 marketplace images referencing sdk:v1.*, 3 published by partners (acme-integrations, globe-systems, dataforge). Posting details to #partners-ops.
Priya (platform): Action items:
- Nina: publish SDK migration doc + 1-page rollback runbook (due Tue EOD)
- Evan: partner email + schedule office hours (due Mon AM)
- Carlos: reach out to top 5 partner leads and collect responses (ongoing)
- Ops: prepare feature flag rollout plan and monitoring alerts
Evan (partnerships): Also: add a marketplace compatibility badge noting if images auto-update to sdk v2.*. That should reduce surprise breakages. Who can own badge work?
Carlos (partner-eng): I'll own badge implementation and coordinate copy with Product.
Evan (partnerships): Thanks. Drop a short ACK when you start your item so we can track. :thumbsup:
Priya (platform): ACK 3 starting ops coordination now.
Nina (eng-sdk): ACK 3 drafting docs, will attach migration snippets.
Carlos (partner-eng): ACK 3 starting partner outreach.
Evan (partnerships): I'll draft the partner email and share for review later today.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder scheduled: office hours invites will be sent after Evan posts times.
Carlos (partner-eng): quick note 3 globe-systems requested a longer deprecation window due to legal review (~3 weeks). We should prepare to grant limited exceptions.
Evan (partnerships): Noted. We'll triage exceptions case-by-case. Thanks everyone.
